notes.title: Boinihi available now
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

A new episode in the Black Cube series (ASA, Catyph, Myha) is here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1298050/Bonihi_The_Ki_Codex/

Scifi adventure game Boinihi is finally released after 4 years of hard work on my own at home! 
Of course I couldn't have succeeded without the help of Yazorius (music), Klemens Koehring (English voice), Rémy Létang (French voice), and all my friends at the Icehouse collective.

Available in English and French for Windows, $19.99 (there's -10% if you choose the Black Cube bundle). 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/617/The_Black_Cube_series/

Don't miss the Bonus files in the game's folder (mp3, video, comic book...)!!

I really hope you like it! Thanks for your support during all these years! 

Simon
